title: Failed local treatment corrected by reusing its remedy at the inferred causal site
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED. Galen I.6 and the separate Pausanias repriseIII.14 preserve a failed application, an explicitly appropriate remedy, revised history and a different application site; Greek relative-correlative reference holds treatment identity while site changes. Physical-dose identity is not licensed.

source_evidence.quote: # Galen: failed application, retained remedy, revised site

design.whole_hypothesis: A whole case discourse records an attempted application, reported failure, targeted history-taking, revised causal-site inference and a new application of the same treatment type at a different site, followed by an attributed outcome. All report/question/explanation clauses must be written under shared syntax, not discarded as free prose.
complete_I6_content_inventory: Author introduces a cure discovered through recognizing the affected site, setting aside the preceding verbal disputes.
A patient has medicine on three fingers and reports thirty days of sensory loss, intact movement and no relief.
Narrator follows his usual method: asks the former physician which drugs were used; judges them appropriate; seeks why no benefit followed.
Patient is asked about preceding symptoms and denies inflammation/cold/blows, reporting gradual loss.
Narrator asks again about a higher body part; patient denies an arm blow but reports upper-back impact; narrator asks how and when.
Patient reports a fall from a vehicle while travelling to Rome, shortly before finger onset.
Narrator conjectures an inflammation that became a scirrhous state where a nerve exits after the seventh vertebra; this is an attributed inference, not an omniscient observed fact.
Anatomical reason: an apparently single nerve is bundled fibres held by common meningeal coverings, analogous in appearance to a vessel.
Inferior portion of the last cervical nerve reaches skin around the small fingers and half the middle finger; that distribution further supports the stated conjecture.
Order removal/discard of the finger medicament; apply treatment at the indicated spinal origin. Keep physical dose identity unproven.
Reported cure of the fingers through medication at the spine, with observers’ surprise, closes the narrative.
separate_reprise_inventory: NamePausanias, Syrian sophist inRome; identify left small two fingers plus half middle finger.
Sensation initially diminished then lost under poor care.
Narrator asks past history; patient had fallen from a vehicle, injured upper back; injured site healed while distal sensation worsened.
Greek what-medicines/these reference orders those previously used medicines applied at the injured site; rapid cure is reported.
Concluding criticism distinguishes skin sensory nerve roots from roots moving muscles.

attested_reference_contract.Greek_relative_correlative: ἃ τοῖς δακτύλοις ἐκεῖνοι προσέφερον φάρμακα, ταῦτ’ ἐκέλευσα κατὰ τοῦ πληγέντος τίθεσθαι μορίου
attested_reference_contract.meaning: The medicines that they applied to the fingers, those I ordered placed at the injured part. The medicine argument is reused; application site changes.
attested_reference_contract.type_limit: Material/treatment identity does not imply same unreduced physical dose; I.6 explicitly says to cast/remove the old application away.
attested_reference_contract.other_context: Former/later reports are attributed; body site, sensed function, motor function and medicine are distinct argument types. No nearest-word-only antecedent rule.

design.joint_consequence: If remedy type is held fixed and the diagnosis is revised to a connected proximal site, the new application must change its site while preserving the patient and impaired sensory-function goal. A new-remedy-at-same-site account or cure-of-motion account cannot preserve all source claims. The anatomical explanation and revised history are required to bind the site change.

rivals.reading: Failure triggers a different drug at the same site.
rivals.failure: Conflicts with appropriate-drug judgment and explicit same-medicine reference.

rivals.reading: Failure means the application intensity/duration alone changed.
rivals.failure: Leaves the explicitly changed anatomical application site and causal history unexplained.

rivals.reading: Sensory and motor dysfunction are one interchangeable state.
rivals.failure: Cannot preserve intact movement alongside absent sensation and the source’s separate neural routes.

rivals.reading: Every reported statement is a timeless true assertion.
rivals.failure: Creates a conflict between initial no-blow report and later back-injury history instead of modelling attribution/scope/revision.

design.writing_debt: No finite surface realization selected. The source supplies ordinary Greek referential constructions and a full narrative, not a compact symbolic codec. A future writer must express all listed content, including explanations, dialogue and negative reports, with shared reusable roles; it may not add per-word glosses or one opaque primitive per sentence.
critical_limits: Original medicament ingredients and dose unknown.
I.6 patient unnamed; III.14 namesPausanias. Reprise identity is a scholarly/source comparison, not independently repeated evidence.
Initial no-blow report has unresolved local scope versus corrected recollection; both retained.
Daremberg bracketed expansions/anatomical parenthetical terms are editorial; Greek owned separately.
Ancient source claim of cure and anatomy not endorsed as modern medical fact.
No confirmed target word or target owner; global entity/role relabeling remains a symmetry.
The full source case adds constraints but does not alone solve whole-passage writing.

predecessors.difference: Celsus conditional replacement and aftercare versus same-remedy relocation from revised history. No target context or gloss inherited.
Qualified prognosis and repeated inquiry versus failed application followed by fixed-remedy changed-site instruction.
Causal apparatus alternatives do not supply this reported failed medical application or relative-correlative treatment reuse.

predecessors.retained: A generic connector can accompany real contrast. The actual multiargument reference and whole explanation must be represented; mere repetition identifies no target marker.

design.structural_baseline: Directed composition, hierarchy at spaces, whole-form residuals and entry context retained. No claim EVA is Greek/Latin alphabet; no target group-count choice.
design.smallest_future_decision: Before any target experiment, select a complete already admitted unit and freeze a writer that expresses the entire case and its report/inference distinctions. Test changed remedy versus changed site under one shared vocabulary; do not use source resemblance alone as binding.
design.access: Source-only apart from one disclosed prior-card source_evidence quote accidentally surfaced by metadata navigation; no target file/raw corpus/images/reserves/results opened or used. No decoder, solver, statistics, contacts, refresh or commit.
